decisions.title: How to store threads/messages given the merged chat code imports models that do not exist in main?
options: Add a new Thread + Message pair of tables against main's real schema (String(64) building ids, FK to events/buildings) and rewire the route + tests onto them; handoff_mode lives on Thread
Resurrect the old-branch stand-in models (int building ids, Message/EventBuilding) and migrate main's schema toward them
decisions.recommended: Add a new Thread + Message pair of tables against main's real schema (String(64) building ids, FK to events/buildings) and rewire the route + tests onto them; handoff_mode lives on Thread
decisions.answer: Add a new Thread + Message pair of tables against main's real schema (String(64) building ids, FK to events/buildings) and rewire the route + tests onto them; handoff_mode lives on Thread

decisions.title: When the Bedrock pipeline errors or an agent reply trips the banned-word check, what should the thread show?
options: Persist the manager message, post one fixed agent message saying a human will follow up, and flag the thread for operator attention
Auto-flip the thread to human mode immediately
decisions.recommended: Persist the manager message, post one fixed agent message saying a human will follow up, and flag the thread for operator attention
decisions.answer: Persist the manager message, post one fixed agent message saying a human will follow up, and flag the thread for operator attention

decisions.title: SMS/Twilio reconciliation scope after the merge

Reconcile the SMS subsystem onto main's schema and keep it
decisions.recommended: Remove SMS entirely (delete Twilio webhook, send_sms, TwilioProvider, SMS templates, User.phone, SMS tests); in-app chat + browser push are the only channels
decisions.answer: Remove SMS entirely (delete Twilio webhook, send_sms, TwilioProvider, SMS templates, User.phone, SMS tests); in-app chat + browser push are the only channels
